intended: Derive blueprint.md from the catalog record on the scaffold commit, write every acceptance check, install the loop machinery. No product code.
done: blueprint.md derived with 12 features and written checks
scripts/verify-phase.mjs, scripts/phase-gate.mjs, git pre-commit hook and agent adapters wired

decisions.choice: An ink-navy ground (#171C2B) with a proofreader's crimson
decisions.over: a near-black ground with a red-orange accent
decisions.why: every near-black and red pairing collided with ear, epoch, anagrid, tuner or floral in the look check

decisions.choice: End-to-end checks stub /api/fetch with responses the real converter produced from fixtures
decisions.why: vite preview runs no Vercel function, Chromium in a cloud session cannot reach outside hosts, and the guard rightly refuses a localhost fixture server

decisions.choice: The preview shows images as labeled links
decisions.over: loading third-party images in the preview
decisions.why: img-src stays 'self', so a preview never tells an image host who is reading

carryForward: The SSRF guard is tested against an injected resolver; any change to how the function connects (a new HTTP client, a proxy) must keep the check on the resolved address of every hop, not on the hostname.

rulesThatHeld: The SSRF guard checks the address the socket connects to on every hop (P0 carryForward); the redirect-to-metadata test proved no second request is made
failuresTheLoopCaught: The e2e suite under the production CSP caught pasted <style> blocks tripping style-src in the paste flow, and an offline fetch reporting the wrong message because the converter chunk failed to load first
house-audit e2e-exact caught a substring locator in the strip spec
Running the handler against real pages caught Readability crashing under linkedom on danluu.com (no <html> or <body>) and card links wrapping headings in brackets
wouldHaveMissedHumanReview: jsdom 27 loads an ES-only module with require(), which Vercel's Node runtime refuses: every /api/fetch call failed in production while 78 unit and 36 e2e tests passed, because Node 22 locally allows require(esm). Playwright's loader hit the same error and the workaround hid the signal
Fragment Mono's => ligature rendered as an arrow in the raw Markdown; only a screenshot showed it

houseRuleCandidates.rule: A Vercel function's dependencies load in a test with require(esm) switched off
houseRuleCandidates.rationale: Vercel's Node runtime refuses require() of an ES module; Node 22 locally allows it, so every local gate passes on a function that cannot start
